extra.reason: Phase 0 skeleton complete: Bun workspace, TanStack Start web app with placeholder login page, Effect xrpc-server + ingester stubs, db/lexicon/common packages, Postgres compose, justfile. bun install / just check / web build all pass. Testnet harness deferred to a follow-up issue.

Tailwind v4 wired into apps/web via @tailwindcss/vite (Vite plugin route, replacing the old repo's Next/PostCSS integration). Ported the full light-dark() token set, @custom-variant dark, @theme inline mapping and @layer base from apps/frontend/src/app/globals.css into apps/web/src/styles.css, keeping every token name. Dropped only the @layer components block, the tw-animate-css import and the base-ui data-open/data-closed variants — all component styling for gallery/upload UI that does not exist here (follow-up ratat-app-cso). Ported scripts/check-color-literals.ts, retargeting GLOBALS_CSS to src/styles.css; wired 'lint:colors' at apps/web and root, plus a 'lint-colors' recipe inside 'just check'. Login placeholder restyled with tokens only. Verified: bun install, just check green, negative test of the colour gate fails as expected, vite build emits compiled utilities, and dev server serves the styles with lightningcss lowering light-dark() correctly for both prefers-color-scheme and data-theme. Follow-ups: ratat-app-263, ratat-app-cso.

Wired @atcute/lex-cli codegen in packages/lexicon. lex.config.ts generates from lexicons-src/**/*.ts into lexicons/ with imports [@atcute/atproto, @atcute/bluesky]; 'bun run --cwd packages/lexicon generate' emits lexicons/index.ts plus lexicons/types/art/ratat/**. Authored art.ratat.actor.defs, art.ratat.actor.getProfile, art.ratat.feed.defs, art.ratat.feed.getAuthorFeed and the one custom record art.ratat.graph.follow (unused until Phase 3, but it is the locked custom lexicon and the generator input the issue named). src/index.ts re-exports ../lexicons/index.ts plus src/collections.ts (nsid constants); package exports expose '.' and './collections'. Generated output is committed and excluded from oxlint/oxfmt via 'packages/lexicon/lexicons/**' ignorePatterns, matching the old repo. Note the acceptance criterion said 'types from lexicons/*.json' — atcute's lex-cli takes TypeScript builder documents as input, not JSON, so the source of truth is lexicons-src/*.ts and 'lex-cli export' is the script that emits JSON. Verified: generate runs clean and 'bun run --cwd packages/lexicon typecheck' passes; the generated schemas are consumed by apps/xrpc-server (router + handlers) and apps/web (typed client).
